text: Follow-up (after 102.001-T lands): update the upstream spike/SKILL.md.tmpl in the external autoharness repo so regeneration preserves the in-repo docline findings-artifact fix (Principle IV, no out-of-tree writes). Refs: 102.001-T, 102-F, docs/exec-plans/2026-07-13-spike-findings-docline-reconciliation-plan.md.

Enable (or formally waive) the formal multi-persona plan-review skill gate. This environment cannot dispatch independent reviewer persona sub-agents, so Stage plans (091-S through 093-S) ran an honest inline single-agent self-assessment instead of the formal .github/skills/plan-review/SKILL.md gate (AGENTS.md:378 orders plan-review -> harvest). Establish a real persona-dispatch path OR a documented operator waiver so the pre-harvest gate is satisfiable and not silently skipped.

Add a labeled 'Constitution Check' section to the impl-plan skill output. Governance requires every implementation plan to map proposed work against the constitution; recent 091-S/092-S/093-S plans omitted an explicitly-labeled Constitution Check section.

Add a persistent regression guard for soft-convention docline keys (chunk_strategy, schema_version). backlogit docs lint currently passes with or without them, so their presence can silently drift; add a lint rule or test to enforce them on doc types where they are expected.

PRODUCT BUG (models/core, archived-item mutation safety): backlogit update (e.g. --commit) on an already-archived item silently drops the archive-only frontmatter keys archived_from and archived_status. Root cause: the typed models.Artifact struct (internal/models/artifact.go:34-55) has no ArchivedFrom/ArchivedStatus fields, and WriteArtifactFile (internal/core/artifacts.go:681-725) re-emits only enumerated recognized keys, so archive-only keys are dropped on write. Consequence: the archive record becomes non-invertible (UnarchiveItem, internal/core/archive.go:675-681, hard-fails 'missing archived_from metadata') and the original pre-archive status is lost; links order is also reshuffled. Fix options: (a) preserve unmodeled archive-only frontmatter keys through the update/write round-trip, or (b) refuse to mutate items in archived status via the update path. See compound learning docs/compound/2026-07-17-backlogit-update-drops-archive-provenance.md.
